summary.text: Ash Kalra represents California's 25th Assembly District, which encompasses the majority of San José; he was first elected in 2016 and was re-elected to his fifth term in 2024. He chairs the Assembly Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: He previously served on the San José City Council for eight years and was a Deputy Public Defender for Santa Clara County for 11 years.

Kalra was born in Toronto, Canada, and moved to California in 1978 as a young child. He has a bachelor's degree in communication from the University of California, Santa Barbara, and a law degree from Georgetown University.
